curve_rejection_algorithm: Compute p_digest, a_digest, b_digest and candidate p,a,b.
If p is composite, emit only P_NOT_PRIME; q,trace,j are null; stop this attempt.
Compute discriminant. If zero, emit only SINGULAR; q,trace,j are null; stop this attempt.
Enumerate E(F_p), then compute q, trace, and j.
Append Q_NOT_ODD_PRIME, TRACE_ZERO_OR_ONE, J_ZERO_OR_1728, CHART_RESIDUES_NOT_DISTINCT in that order for every predicate that fails.
If no predicate fails, reasons is exactly [ACCEPTED].
derivation_amendment.operation_accounting: Operation counters are not members of semantic derivation attempt records and are not covered by transcript equality. Producer and verifier operation counters live only in their independent accounting receipts under source-schema-v3.
